lens: human connection, trust, agency, communication, collaboration

findings.observation: Today renders the canonical targetOutcome field under the label "Outcome". In frozen screenshot canonical-today.png (sha256 a45443bf98f0066db22fe0bd4874f5ed836cd45a9a77f17bb52718accc82dc13), the card says "OUTCOME Accepted Offer" while the same card says "STATE Milestone Shortlist Review" and still shows unresolved final-conversation availability. RelationshipArchiveView.swift:469 confirms that item.targetOutcome is presented as "Outcome".
findings.user_impact: A recruiter can read the desired endpoint as an achieved candidate state and communicate or plan from an inaccurate premise. No frozen test shows an external message being sent, but the ambiguity weakens the truthful human judgment that should precede any future candidate-facing action.
findings.recommendation: Label this value "Target outcome" or "Desired outcome" everywhere and keep the current milestone/status visually distinct; never let a desired endpoint read as a confirmed candidate decision.
findings.verification: Freeze a Pursuit whose target outcome is Accepted Offer but current milestone is Shortlist Review; Today and its accessibility output must say "Target outcome: Accepted Offer" and separately "Current milestone: Shortlist Review", with no assertion or copy implying acceptance occurred.

findings.observation: The frozen Today card falls back to the raw value "Observed 2026-08-24T02:57:08.067Z · Asia/Shanghai" instead of a localized time and relative age. WorkspaceDate.evidenceFreshness uses ISO8601DateFormatter().date(from:) without enabling fractional-second parsing, then returns the raw input while appending the source timezone when parsing fails.
findings.user_impact: The raw UTC timestamp followed by a different timezone name can be mistaken for a localized observation time, and the missing relative age makes it harder to judge whether a candidate deserves a prompt response. That creates avoidable delay or poorly timed follow-up even though the underlying evidence remains intact.
findings.recommendation: Parse ISO 8601 values with and without fractional seconds, then show a clearly localized absolute time plus relative age; if parsing truly fails, label the timestamp as raw/unparsed rather than pairing it ambiguously with another timezone.
findings.verification: Run a deterministic Today fixture with observedAt 2026-08-24T02:57:08.067Z and source timezone Asia/Shanghai while the device uses a different timezone; the row must show the correct Asia/Shanghai wall time and relative age, and must not expose the raw Z timestamp as if it were localized.

findings.observation: The audio authorization form uses "Who authorized this recording?" and "Authorization basis..." only as TextField placeholders. Once values are entered, the frozen saved-state screenshots show filled controls without persistent field labels, although the durable receipt later spells out the authorization record.
findings.user_impact: On a compact or high-Dynamic-Type screen, the recruiter can lose the distinction between who granted permission and the authorization basis while reviewing entered values. Confusing those fields can weaken the audit record that protects the candidate's informed consent, though the final receipt and revoke-and-delete control reduce the harm.
findings.recommendation: Keep persistent visible labels for authorizing party and authorization basis after entry, and preserve matching accessibility labels and value readback.
findings.verification: Fill both authorization fields on the 375x667 AX5 dark-mode journey; both visible labels must remain associated with their values without clipping, and a human VoiceOver pass must read each label-value pair distinctly before recording starts.

strengths: Same-name capture does not preselect a Person or Pursuit, and the frozen binding receipt names the exact Person, role, context, capture, and evidence resource while stating that no Pursuit field changed; this materially reduces harm from contacting or updating the wrong candidate.

Proposal review and owned-action outcome paths expose revision, owner, recorded outcome, canonical receipt, and no external side effect. The frozen P0 journeys pass 12/12 with 64 assertions and external_effect_count 0, so V1 keeps consequential communication under human ownership rather than presenting agent activity as relationship work.

Audio capture requires purpose, authorizing party, authorization basis, and attestation; the saved receipt retains authorization scope and time, and the UI offers revoke authorization and delete recording. This is a strong candidate-consent guardrail within the tested local-only boundary.

Today preserves every attention-bearing Pursuit without a display cap and exposes blocker, evidence, owner, due work, next action, and current state. That supports timely human follow-through without ranking a person's worth or using acceptance-probability theater.

Response-loss, stale revision, duplicate receipt, deletion, interruption, workspace isolation, and no-action paths are exercised without false success or external effects, protecting candidates from hidden or duplicated automation during internal V1 use.
missing_evidence: No authorized candidate-side experience artifact or candidate feedback exists, so actual candidate trust, clarity, felt respect, correction experience, and communication closure remain unobserved; recruiter-side internal UI is not candidate-facing proof.
No design-partner recruiter field comparison exists, so the effect on real follow-through, ghosting, collaboration accountability, and candidate wait time is not demonstrated.

Manual VoiceOver traversal by a human across the complete critical journey is missing; AX5 simulator screenshots and automated accessibility assertions do not establish spoken order, label-value comprehension, focus recovery, or rotor usability.
Physical-device Action Button, microphone, and system-capture privacy behavior is missing, including interruption, permission, indicator, route-change, and deletion behavior on real hardware.
Five credentialed live Claude Agent SDK trials against the frozen evaluator are missing; the deterministic 30/30 agent trials prove the harness boundary but not live-model behavior.

Production authentication, retention and deletion operations, regional controls, provider reconciliation, and cross-tenant adversarial behavior are missing; the frozen artifact intentionally proves only the internal V1 boundary with zero external effects.
Real candidate data was intentionally excluded and must remain excluded from this panel; therefore no production or field claim can be inferred from the synthetic fixtures.
open_questions: When candidate-facing communication enters scope, what explicit service promise will define owner, expected response window, status-change notice, correction path, and dignified closure without introducing silent automation?

Will the first field pilot measure candidate waiting time and missed/late follow-up outcomes alongside recruiter task completion, rather than treating internal receipt completion as proof of a good candidate experience?
